text:
maria: Brainstorm: shrink left nav to three pillars (Projects, Model hub, Observability) and move other entries into contextual flyouts. Aim: declutter + predictable permalinks. feedback?

sam: +1 for declutter. Concern: stable breadcrumbs for sharing/copy-paste.

lina: Breadcrumbs must always reflect full resource path (Org > Project > Model > Versions) even if sidebar label collapses. That keeps integrations stable.

alex: Agree. Also standardize routing: prefer canonical full-path URLs (no hash). Reserve hash for transient UI flags only.

maria: Mock examples: `https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/redwood/projects/ember/models/ember-13b?panel=metrics` and ephemeral like `#inspect=open`.

ethan: Accessibility: when collapsing, ensure keyboard focus order follows logical structure and flyouts announce via aria-live. Also trap focus in interactive flyouts.

sam: UX question: click a subitem in collapsed group  expand then navigate or navigate keeping collapsed?

lina: Navigate while keeping collapsed to save space, but briefly highlight the parent or show a polite toast "Located in Model hub" with aria-live.

alex: For legacy deep links, add a routing shim that maps old hash routes to new full paths for a migration window (6 months). Log and telemetry for unmatched patterns.

maria: Dev ops: add `legacy_route_handled=true` telemetry when shim triggers, and log unmatched for 30d.

prod-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/compact-leftnav-2026 (preview/compact-leftnav-2026).

sam: I'll run a quick a11y sweep tomorrow. checklist: focus order, live announcements, keyboard expand/collapse, link text clarity.

lina: Copy tweak: prefer "Model hub" label when compacted. Ensure breadcrumbs use resource names not UI labels.

alex: Bookmark policy: canonical path + stable query params only (e.g., `?eval=789`). Avoid serializing ephemeral panel state. Publish allowed query keys.

maria: Next: ship preview to design + a11y, sam to audit, eng to add telemetry shims, product to lock query param contract. I'll attach updated mocks here soon. :sparkles:
